![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/cmtitle.svg)

**Action Combat Mode** brings modern action-game controls to *World of Warcraft*, replacing traditional tab-targeting with intuitive aiming, more engaging controls, and immersive combat.

## ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/cmlogo.svg) FEATURES

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/reticle_targeting.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/cast_at_crosshair.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/mouse_look.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/click_casting.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/crosshair.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/assist_hud.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/radial_menu.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/party_wheel.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/target_lock.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/ally_cycle.gif)

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/auto_unlock.gif)

## ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/cmlogo.svg) DOWNLOAD

Grab it on [**CurseForge**](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/combat-mode) or [**Wago Addons**](https://addons.wago.io/addons/combat-mode).

## ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/cmlogo.svg) INSTRUCTIONS

After installing the AddOn, you'll be greeted by this message. Click Okay to proceed and follow the Setup Wizard.

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/welcome_msg.png)

## ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/cmlogo.svg) SUPPORT

You can report bugs, request features and provide feedback over on our [**Discord**](https://www.discord.gg/5mwBSmz).

## ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/cmlogo.svg) LICENSE

Free to use, not to redistribute or sell. Contributions through pull requests are welcome. See the [LICENSE](https://github.com/ThericGames/combatmode/blob/develop/LICENSE) for the full terms.

## ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/cmlogo.svg) ARCHITECTURE

Action Combat Mode is organized by **domain**. Runtime lives under `CombatMode/Core/`; settings under `CombatMode/UI/`; static tables under `CombatMode/Constants/`.

| Domain | Owns |
|--------|------|
| **Runtime** | AddOn shell, events, CVars, binding queue, bootstrap (`Core/Runtime/`) |
| **FreeLook** | Mouse Look state, auto cursor unlock, flip camera, vignette |
| **Crosshair** | Reticle, Assist HUD (next-cast suggestion and interactable indicator), Target Lock marker, cast animations |
| **ClickCasting** | Mouse/key override bindings, Reticle Targeting macros, composed macros |
| **AllyCycle** | Party/raid ally cycling + Ally HUD (secure Next/Previous, help/harm macros) |
| **RadialMenu** | Radial Menu wheels and the Party Wheel |
| **Options / Wizard** | Standalone options window, editors and the first-run setup wizard (`UI/`) |

Load order and public entry points: **[STRUCTURE.md](https://github.com/ThericGames/combatmode/blob/develop/STRUCTURE.md)**.

## ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThericGames/combatmode/develop/media/cmlogo.svg) CONTRIBUTING

Pull requests to [**Action Combat Mode's repository on GitHub**](https://github.com/ThericGames/combatmode) are welcome. See **[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ThericGames/combatmode/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)** for setup, the PR flow and the automatic checks; architecture and coding rules are in **[CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/ThericGames/combatmode/blob/develop/CLAUDE.md)**.

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/2.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [5.5.4] - 2026-11-26

### Added

- **Initial Mouse Look State** in the **Mouse Look** tab sets whether **Mouse Look** is on or off after a loading screen. The default, **Remember Last State**, keeps it as you left it through loading screens and reloads, so a cursor you freed now stays free after a reload. Logging in still starts with it on.

### Changed

- The **Party Wheel** health rings have a new status bar look and now fill and drain smoothly as health changes. The swipe animation on the centre spell is a little larger too.

### Fixed

- **Feign Death** now frees your cursor right away in combat, so moving your mouse no longer makes you stand back up.

## [5.5.3] - 2026-11-26

### Added

- **Unlock for Ping** in **Auto Unlock**, on by default. Hold a **Ping** key to aim with a free cursor, and release it to return to **Mouse Look**. Turn it off to keep pinging with the crosshair.
- **Unlock for Chat** in **Auto Unlock**, on by default. The cursor is released while you type in chat, and **Mouse Look** returns when you're done.
- **Hide Focus Frame** in the **Target Lock** section, off by default and shared by all your characters. Hides Blizzard's focus frame while keeping your focus and **Target Lock**.
- **Support Mode** has a new **Auto Lock Allies** option, on by default. Turn it off to keep **Auto Target Lock** for enemies without it locking the allies you heal. Manual **Target Lock** works either way.
- On Forever and Classic, **Party Wheel Spells**, **Excluded Spells** and **Cast at Crosshair** have a new **All Ranks** pick. One entry covers every rank of a spell, including ones you train later.
- **Radial Menu Scale** in the **Radial Menu** tab resizes the **Radial Menu** and **Party Wheel**.

### Fixed

- The **Party Wheel** now casts the spell rank that's on the key you hold.

## [5.5.2] - 2026-11-19

### Added

- **Support Mode** has a new **Self-Cast Keybind**. Hold it and the helpful spells on your click-cast buttons land on you, without changing your target or **Target Lock**.
- **Support Mode** has a new **Cycle in Group Order** option. Turn it on and the **Cycle Lock** keys move through your party or raid in group order, instead of jumping to the nearest player. With nobody locked, **Next** locks the first member of your group and **Previous** the last.

### Changed

- The **Radial Menu** now opens with its wheel name in the centre. The close X appears only after you aim a slice and return to the centre.

### Fixed

- Your edits in the **Prelines Editor** now apply to harmful spells on click-cast buttons and bar keys while the **Ally Cycle** keys are bound. Before, the built-in preline was used instead. A long preline that would push the macro past the 255-character limit now drops the restore-after-harm retarget line instead of cutting it in half.
- Friendly pet and minion nameplates, which the **Cycle Lock** keys skip, are now hidden when **Cycle NPCs and Pets** is off, in and out of **Support Mode**. Turning the option on restores your own setting.
- Keys and click-cast buttons on a bar slot that holds a macro on another stance, form or stealth bar no longer stop working after you swap bars in combat (a rogue leaving stealth with an opener, a warrior changing stance). Before, the slot did nothing until combat ended. Such a slot now uses the game's own binding, so its spell skips **Reticle Targeting**.
- Click-cast buttons no longer stop working after you switch **Support Mode** on or off when the action bar slot holds a macro (such as a **Reticle Targeting Macro**) on one page and a spell on the other. Before, the button did nothing until you reloaded.

## [5.5.1] - 2026-11-13

### Added

- The **Reticle Targeting Macros** list has an **"i" button** too.

### Changed

- The **"i" buttons** explain each feature in more detail, and their tooltip now reads "Learn more about this feature".
- The **Extra Frames** window picker has a new magnifying-glass button.
- The **Appearance** presets include a new **Dot**.
- **Minimum Zoom** and the crosshair's **Vertical Position** are now saved per character. Your current values carry over to each of your characters.
- The **Target Lock** marker now sends out a soft pulse every few seconds.

### Fixed

- The **Cycle Lock** keys in Support Mode now skip NPCs and pets and only move between players. The new **Cycle NPCs and Pets** option brings them back.
- The Target Lock marker on an ally now uses the **Support** texture while Support Mode is on.

## [5.5.0] - 2026-11-11

### Added

- **Support Mode**, a toggle with its own options tab and keybind (needs Reticle Targeting). It switches your main action bar to a dedicated support page and lets helpful spells on your click-cast buttons target the friendly unit under your crosshair, else your friendly target (such as an **Ally Cycle** pick), else the ally the game soft-targets in front of you. With no ally to take the spell, the game's own Self Cast setting decides whether it lands on you (Auto Self Cast and the Self Cast key both work). Friendly soft targeting is switched on while the mode is on. Harmful spells keep targeting enemies. It works in combat.
  - **Prioritize Crosshair Target** (off by default) puts the ally under your crosshair ahead of other friendly targets, such as an Ally Cycle pick (Target Lock still comes first), and the ally who takes the heal becomes your target. Leave it off to prioritize your selected target; the heal then leaves your target alone.
  - **Target Lock** works on allies while the mode is on. The Target Lock key locks your friendly target, or the ally you aim at, and the **Cycle Lock** keys move the lock to the next or previous nearby friendly unit. Helpful spells on your click-cast buttons go to the locked ally first, and the lock marker takes the Support color. With **Auto Target Lock** on, the ally you heal with a click-cast button is locked automatically, the way an enemy is when you attack; harmful spells don't lock enemies while the mode is on. Switching modes drops a lock the new mode can't use: a hostile lock when you enter Support Mode, a friendly one when you leave it.
  - **Support Bar Page** is the main action bar page shown while the mode is on (page 2 by default). Place your support abilities there; leaving the mode returns to page 1.
  - **Nameplate Behavior** picks which nameplates show while Support Mode is on: friendly only (the default), friendly and enemy, none, or your own settings unchanged. Your settings come back when you leave.
  - The crosshair shows the mode: it switches to a **Support** texture (pick another, or turn it off, in **Appearance** on the Crosshair tab) and turns a mint green while idle (the new **Support** tab of **Reaction Colors**). Entering and leaving the mode swaps the reticle with a lock-out of the old look and a lock-in of the new one.
  - **Tint Vignette** gives the Vignette that same color while Support Mode is on, as a soft, slowly breathing glow. It shows only when your Vignette does.
  - The **Setup Wizard** has a **Support Mode** step, with screenshots and a check for your Support Mode key.
- **Reset All Colors** button in the **Reaction Colors** editor, to clear every custom crosshair color at once.
- **Also Cycle Through** on the **Ally Cycle** tab: add **Your Pet** and/or **Party Pets** (everyone else's pets) to the cycle, after the group members. The Ally HUD shows a targeted pet with a gold paw-print crest in place of the role icon, and the count includes them. **Your Pet** is on by default.
- A small gold **"i" button** beside each section header and option that the **Setup Wizard** covers. Click it to read that feature's explanation, with its screenshots, in a popup, without running the tour.
